# Intel — First-Party Visitor Identity & Network Intelligence

Intel is a first-party visitor identity and network-intelligence dashboard. It shows what a
visiting browser or automated agent looks like to the site itself: device and OS hints, network
and geolocation data derived from the connection, and a bot / automation verdict. All data is
collected first-party — there are no third-party cookies and no cross-site trackers.

## What it does

- Issues a first-party visitor identity for a browsing session and stores the visit history
  locally (private history is never exposed publicly).
- Reports network intelligence: connection-derived geolocation, ASN / organization, transport
  details, and client hints where the browser provides them.
- Detects named AI agents and crawlers from their real User-Agent and, when present, verified
  Web Bot Auth (RFC 9421) signatures. Detected agents are shown publicly in the
  **Bot & Automation Detection** section of the dashboard.
- Is transparent about uncertainty: signals that require paid or privileged data are reported
  as unavailable rather than guessed.

## Key URLs

- / — the dashboard.
- /api/health — health check (`{"status":"ok"}`).
- /api/intel/geolocation — connection-derived geolocation for the current visitor.

## For AI agents and crawlers

Named assistants and crawlers (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-User,
Claude-SearchBot, Googlebot, Applebot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Amazonbot, Bingbot,
CCBot, MistralAI-User, Manus-User, GrokBot, GrokAgent) are detected and shown in the
**Bot & Automation Detection** section. Identify yourself with your real User-Agent and sign
requests with Web Bot Auth where available. See /agents.md for agent instructions and
/robots.txt for the advisory crawl policy.

## Privacy and contact

First-party only; no third-party cookies. Private visit history is not publicly listed.
Documentation and the full source are maintained in the project repository; see the site's
README / documentation links for implementation and API details.
